candidates.message: Want to finish the ThinkPad X1 vs MacBook Air decision before you start on the 1st? The open questions were Windows-only software at work and how much the keyboard matters.
candidates.rationale: The decision was paused with 'let's pick this up later' and the job starts December 1.

candidates.message: Thought for your train commute: a laptop that runs on standby for days matters as much as raw battery hours when you only open it between stations.
candidates.rationale: They are on trains a lot; an angle on battery life they did not mention.
